say:1:1522111001:1.text: Are you here to convince Abundius and Perseus to stop the war?
say:1:1522111001:1.source_cn: 你也是来游说阿邦德和珀尔修斯停战的吗？

say:3:1522111002:0.text: Save us? How arrogant! Halia's under the protection of the God of Harvest. We don't need saving from the Arcane Council!
say:3:1522111002:0.source_cn: 你这是什么态度？呼临城有丰饶神庇护，不需要魔法师协会的拯救！
say:3:1522111002:0.male: Save us? How arrogant! Halia's under the protection of the God of Harvest. We don't need saving from the Arcane Council!
say:3:1522111002:0.female: Save us? How arrogant! Halia's under the protection of the God of Harvest. We don't need saving from the Arcane Council!

say:5:1522111004:1.text: Keeps sticking her nose in Halia's affairs.
say:5:1522111004:1.source_cn: 她一直试图干涉呼临城的内政！
say:5:1522111004:1.male: Keeps sticking her nose in Halia's affairs.
say:5:1522111004:1.female: Keeps sticking her nose in Halia's affairs.

say:6:1522111005:0.text: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.
say:6:1522111005:0.source_cn: 从我们向兽人宣战开始，她就三番五次地来到呼临城，请求觐...
say:6:1522111005:0.male: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.
say:6:1522111005:0.female: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.

say:7:1522111006:0.text: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!
say:7:1522111006:0.source_cn: 阿邦德不肯见她，她就敢直接找上珀尔修斯和我！真是不知天...
say:7:1522111006:0.male: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!
say:7:1522111006:0.female: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!

say:8:1522111007:0.text: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
say:8:1522111007:0.source_cn: 如果她不改变她的态度，就算她再字字珠玑，再直点要害，呼...
say:8:1522111007:0.male: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
say:8:1522111007:0.female: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

choice_prompt:9:1522111007.text: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
choice_prompt:9:1522111007.source_cn: 如果她不改变她的态度，就算她再字字珠玑，再直点要害，呼临城也不会听从她的劝诫。她那点嘴皮功夫，不如去劝兽人与我们和谈，或许还唬得住！
choice_prompt:9:1522111007.male: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
choice_prompt:9:1522111007.female: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

say:10:1522111008:0.text: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!
say:10:1522111008:0.source_cn: 那又如何？置之死地而后生！就是因为呼临城被天灾逼上了绝...
say:10:1522111008:0.male: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!
say:10:1522111008:0.female: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!

say:11:1522111009:0.text: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.
say:11:1522111009:0.source_cn: 我看你还像是个明事理的人，劝你一句，别再妄想和平，更别...
say:11:1522111009:0.male: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.
say:11:1522111009:0.female: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.

say:12:1522111010:0.text: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.
say:12:1522111010:0.source_cn: 和平和战争，早已不是哪个人或是哪几个人就能够决定的了。
say:12:1522111010:0.male: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.
say:12:1522111010:0.female: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.

choice_prompt:13:1522111007.text: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
choice_prompt:13:1522111007.source_cn: 如果她不改变她的态度，就算她再字字珠玑，再直点要害，呼临城也不会听从她的劝诫。她那点嘴皮功夫，不如去劝兽人与我们和谈，或许还唬得住！
choice_prompt:13:1522111007.male: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
choice_prompt:13:1522111007.female: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

say:14:1522111011:0.text: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.
say:14:1522111011:0.source_cn: 你不明白。政治不是一门简单的课程。
say:14:1522111011:0.male: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.
say:14:1522111011:0.female: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.

say:15:1522111013:0.text: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.
say:15:1522111013:0.source_cn: 别再打听了。事关呼临城内政，我不可能告诉你那么多。
say:15:1522111013:0.male: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.
say:15:1522111013:0.female: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.

say:16:1522111014:1.text: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.
say:16:1522111014:1.source_cn: 你们只要知道，和平和战争都不易，这就足够了。
say:16:1522111014:1.male: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.
say:16:1522111014:1.female: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.

say:18:1522111012:0.text: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.
say:18:1522111012:0.source_cn: 声望和民心有时是同一个东西，有时又不是。
say:18:1522111012:0.male: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.
say:18:1522111012:0.female: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 珀尔修斯不是很有声望吗？

choice:9:0:1.text: The Wildborn fight harder than you.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔人可比你们勇猛多了
choice:9:0:1.male: The Wildborn fight harder than you.
choice:9:0:1.female: The Wildborn fight harder than you.

choice:9:1:2.text: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 遭受饥荒的可不是雅库伯尔
choice:9:1:2.male: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!
choice:9:1:2.female: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我是为了拯救呼临城而来！

say:19:1522111003:1.text: She has. Stubborn, arrogant, always meddling. I don't like her.
say:19:1522111003:1.source_cn: 是的。执拗又骄傲的年轻人，我不喜欢她这种人。
say:19:1522111003:1.male: She has. Stubborn, arrogant, always meddling. I don't like her.
